title: City Council regular meeting, October 13, 2026
summary: Public hearing on the Juniper Creek trail extension, the fiscal 2027 fee schedule and a contract for the Main Street repaving.
body:
• Public comment
  • Public hearing: Juniper Creek trail extension, phase 2
  • Ordinance adopting the fiscal 2027 fee schedule (second reading)
  • Contract award: Main Street repaving, 1st to 9th Street
  • Appointments to the Library Advisory Board

title: Planning and Zoning Commission, October 15, 2026
summary: Zoning change for 14 acres at Ridge Road and FM 1960, and a preliminary plat for Cedar Hollow phase 3.
body:
• Public hearing: zoning change from agricultural to mixed residential, 14 acres at Ridge Road and FM 1960
  • Preliminary plat: Cedar Hollow, phase 3

title: Parks and Recreation Board, October 20, 2026
summary: Update on the splash pad at Eastside Park and the 2027 youth sports fee proposal.
body:
• Eastside Park splash pad update
  • 2027 youth sports fees

title: City Council regular meeting, October 27, 2026
summary: The agenda will be posted by 6 pm on Friday, October 23.
body: The agenda will be posted at least 72 hours before the meeting.

title: Utility Commission, November 2, 2026
summary: Drought contingency plan review and the north water tower project.
body: The agenda will be posted at least 72 hours before the meeting.

title: City Council regular meeting, September 22, 2026
summary: Adopted the fiscal 2027 budget and tax rate, and approved the downtown parking study.
body:
• Adopted the fiscal 2027 budget (6 to 1)
  • Adopted the 2026 tax rate of $0.4875 per $100 valuation
  • Approved the downtown parking study

title: Library Advisory Board, October 1, 2026
summary: Reviewed the new laptop lending policy and the Eastside branch hours.
body:
• Laptop and hotspot lending policy
  • Eastside branch Sunday hours pilot

title: Planning and Zoning Commission, September 17, 2026
summary: Recommended approval of the Old Mill district design standards.
body: • Old Mill district design standards: recommended for approval (5 to 2)

title: City Council regular meeting, September 8, 2026
summary: Public hearings on the proposed budget and tax rate.
body:
• Public hearing: proposed fiscal 2027 budget
  • Public hearing: proposed 2026 tax rate

title: Board of Adjustment, September 28, 2026
body: This meeting was cancelled because there were no cases to hear.
